## Description

Employs Fourier Neural Operators to solve stochastic optimal control problems in infinite-dimensional function spaces, generating continuous dynamic hedging policies for complex option portfolios.

## Where it may fit

Exotic options hedging, large structured products portfolios, dynamic risk management under market friction.

## Vehicles

Institutional Options Market Makers, Structured Products Desks.

## Required data

Option Greeks, implied volatility surfaces, spot underlying paths, transaction cost schedules.

## Caveats

Neural operator training requires high-resolution functional discretization of state spaces.
